answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded work gate, not a story. To mint a fresh identity an agent must first grind a one-time hash proof whose difficulty tracks join pressure, then stake a walnut-sized deposit that unlocks only after many honest epochs. A public beacon publishes the current join bits and slash rules so peers can verify cost without trusting a coordinator. New agents stay in a lotus probation ring until that stake seasons; cloning many shells burns compute and capital per head, so fake farms fail the cost curve before they vote.
